SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.order_no, g.goods_name, g.original_price, sg.seckill_price, 1 AS count, sg.seckill_price AS pay_amount, o.order_status, o.create_time, o.pay_time FROM seckill_order o LEFT JOIN seckill_goods sg ON o.seckill_goods_id = sg.id AND sg.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN goods g ON sg.goods_id = g.id WHERE o.is_delete = 0
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.orderNo}, '%')
AND o.order_status = #{query.payStatus}
ORDER BY o.id ASC
